visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female speaker with long reddish-orange hair, wearing a pink long-sleeved shirt, stands in the center of the frame against a backdrop of dark brown pleated curtains. She is looking directly at the camera with a friendly expression, gesturing with her hands to emphasize her speech. The lighting is bright and professionally set, illuminating her face clearly. (2) A transition occurs to a white digital screen overlay featuring a financial chart from Investing.com. The chart shows a volatile red line graph that drops and then recovers; a green circle highlights a 'V' shaped recovery point. The text and lines are crisp and technical in appearance. (3) The visual shifts to a Google Finance chart for TSMC (2330 - TPE), showing a green price line trending upwards. A bold red arrow is overlaid on the screen, pointing from a lower price point of 780 to a higher point near 1000, illustrating stock growth. (4) A news article snippet appears on the screen, featuring a small photo of Donald Trump and a headline in Chinese characters regarding a visit to Middle Eastern countries. The text is formatted like a web news portal with a white background and blue links.
